files.README.md:
Depot load report - distribution desk
=====================================

depot_rollup.py builds the crates-handled report for the cold-chain
depots. The desk runs it from the project root with

    python3 depot_rollup.py

and it has to search the whole project tree for the depots'
shipments-*.csv export files. The depots file their sheets wherever
their own tooling puts them, including week folders under a depot, so a
search that stops at the depot level will miss sheets.

Every shipments-*.csv row:

    load_id,produce,depot,crates

    load_id    identifies one physical load
    produce    produce line the load carried
    depot      depot that dispatched the load
    crates     crates on that load

A load_id identifies a single physical load; totals are taken over
loads, not over export rows.

The report, written to standard output:

    produce,crates
    <produce>,<crates>    one line per produce line, ascending
    total,<crates>

files.ops/coldchain_sop.md:
Cold-chain dispatch SOP (excerpt)
================================

  - Loads leaving a depot above 6 C are flagged for re-icing.
  - The coastal depot dispatches before 05:00 during heat alerts.
  - Highlands loads are consolidated at the week-38 staging bay.
